_note: Editable build cheatsheet shown by the editor's 'Builds' button. Card/relic effects are mined from the game's pck (reliable); archetype groupings and 'go-to' picks are mechanics-based judgment, not a scraped tier list. Relics in StS2 are mostly shared by rarity (not class-locked except starters), so these are matched by SYNERGY. Edit freely.

archetypes.name: Shivs (Blade Volume)
archetypes.summary: Flood each turn with 0-cost Shiv attacks. Shivs count as Attacks, so they trigger per-attack relics absurdly fast. You scale with FLAT per-Shiv bonuses (add +X, throw 8 Shivs = +8X).
cards: Accuracy — Shivs deal additional damage (the core scaler; upgrade it)
Phantom Blades — Shivs gain Retain; first Shiv each turn hits for +9
Cloak and Dagger — gain Block AND add Shivs
Blade Dance — add a burst of Shivs
Infinite Blades — +1 Shiv at the start of every turn, forever
Storm of Steel — discard your hand; add a Shiv per card discarded
Sharp Edge — every Shiv you create is Upgraded
Finisher — deal damage for EACH Attack played this turn (kill button)
Knife Trap — play every Shiv in your Exhaust pile at the enemy
relics: Shuriken — gain Strength every N Attacks in a turn (best-in-slot; Strength buffs every Shiv)
Pen Nib — every 10th Attack deals double (you hit 10 fast)
The Boot — raises tiny unblocked hits to a floor (huge for low-damage Shivs)
Kunai — gain Dexterity every N Attacks (Block scaling)
Ornamental Fan — gain Block every N Attacks
Helical Dart — play a Shiv, gain Dexterity (snowballs)
Ninja Scroll — start each combat with free Shivs in hand
combos: Dump 6-8 Shivs, then Finisher for a one-shot
Accuracy + Sharp Edge = a stream of upgraded, buffed Shivs
The Boot turns 4-damage Shivs into reliable chunks; Shuriken beats Kunai for damage (Strength hits every Shiv)
archetypes.pitfalls: Don't over-collect generators (3+ floods your hand and dilutes draws to the payoffs). The payoffs win games; Shivs are just ammo.

archetypes.name: Poison (Damage-over-time)
archetypes.summary: Stack Poison; it ticks every turn and ignores Block. Excellent vs high-HP bosses and elites. You're racing to ramp Poison faster than the enemy can kill you, so pair with early survival.
cards: Noxious Fumes — apply Poison to ALL enemies every turn (the engine)
Deadly Poison — cheap burst of Poison
Bouncing Flask — apply Poison to a random enemy several times
Bubble Bubble — if the enemy already has Poison, apply more (snowball)
Envenom — whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, also apply Poison (turns Shivs into poison spam)
Corpse Explosion — on the enemy's death, spread its Poison to others (AoE finisher)
Malaise — strip enemy Strength and apply Weak (control vs scary attackers)
relics: Snecko Skull — every Poison you apply applies +1 extra (compounds the whole ramp)
Twisted Funnel — apply Poison to ALL enemies at the start of each combat
combos: Noxious Fumes + Snecko Skull = compounding AoE that snowballs every turn
Envenom + lots of small attacks (Shivs!) = a poison-application machine
Bubble Bubble after any poison source = cheap doubling
archetypes.pitfalls: Slow to come online — you need Block/survival early or you die before the DoT lands. Weak against very short fights and enemies that wipe debuffs.

archetypes.name: Discard / Hand-Cycling (engine, not a wincon)
archetypes.summary: Discarding triggers payoffs and cycles your deck fast to find combos and refund energy. This is the GLUE that powers a Shiv or Poison kill engine — it isn't damage by itself.
cards: Calculated Gamble — discard your hand, then draw that many (huge churn + discard triggers)
Acrobatics — draw cards, discard 1
Reflex — draw cards (and refunds value when discarded)
Tactician — gain Energy when discarded (your energy engine)
Expertise — draw up to a full hand
relics: Gambling Chip — discard any number of cards then redraw at combat start (sets up turn 1)
Tingsha — discard a card during your turn, deal damage to a random enemy (damage engine)
Tough Bandages — discard a card, gain Block (defense engine)
combos: Calculated Gamble + Tingsha = mass-discard burst damage
Calculated Gamble + Tough Bandages = mass-discard wall of Block
Discard pairs with Shivs/Poison as the delivery system
archetypes.pitfalls: Discard alone wins nothing — always pair it with a real damage archetype (Shivs or Poison). Note: Runic Pyramid (keep your hand) is the OPPOSITE plan — don't mix it in.

archetypes.name: Support: Survival / Dexterity
archetypes.summary: Splash cards/relics that keep you alive while Shivs or Poison ramp. Not a standalone build.
cards: Footwork — gain Dexterity (more Block from every Block card)
Blur — Block carries to next turn
After Image — gain Block whenever you play a card (great with high card volume)
relics: Sturdy Clamp — some Block persists across turns
Vambrace — double your first Block from a card each combat
Sai — gain Block at the start of your turn
combos: After Image + Shiv volume = passive Block stacking every turn
archetypes.pitfalls: Pure defense doesn't close games — keep enough offense to actually kill.

archetypes.name: Strength
archetypes.summary: Stack permanent Strength so every Attack hits harder, then multiply it. Multi-hit attacks turn each point of Strength into several points of damage.
cards: Inflame — gain Strength (flat)
Limit Break — double your current Strength (the multiplier)
Demon Form — gain Strength at the start of every turn (scaling power)
Rupture — whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain Strength
Spot Weakness / Vicious — apply Vulnerable and gain Strength for each Vulnerable on the enemy
Twin Strike / Sword Boomerang / Whirlwind — multi-hit attacks that each gain your Strength
Bludgeon — a single huge hit to dump Strength into
relics: Vajra / Sword of Jade — start each combat with Strength
Ruined Helmet — double your first Strength gain each combat
Girya — bank Strength at rest sites (up to 3)
Red Skull — extra Strength while at low HP
Sling of Courage — start elite fights with Strength
combos: Demon Form + Limit Break = exponential Strength
Ruined Helmet + your first Strength card = a doubled head start
High Strength + any multi-hit (Whirlwind/Twin Strike) = damage scales per hit
archetypes.pitfalls: Strength is slow turn 1 — don't durdle stacking it against fast elites. Needs a payoff hit; raw Strength with no big/multi-hit attack does nothing.

archetypes.name: Block / Barricade
archetypes.summary: Keep Block between turns with Barricade, then convert that stockpile into damage. The tankiest, most consistent Ironclad shell.
cards: Barricade — Block is no longer removed at the start of your turn (the keystone)
Body Slam — deal damage equal to your current Block (the payoff)
Juggernaut — whenever you gain Block, deal damage to a random enemy
Impervious — a single huge chunk of Block
Feel No Pain — gain Block whenever a card is Exhausted
Shrug It Off / Iron Wave — efficient Block (+ a little offense)
relics: Sturdy Clamp — Block persists across turns (a poor-man's Barricade)
Vambrace — double your first Block from a card each combat
Orichalcum — gain Block if you end your turn with none
Cloak Clasp — Block for each card left in your hand at end of turn
Tungsten Rod — lose less HP from every source (survival)
Bronze Scales — start each combat with Thorns
combos: Barricade + Body Slam = stack Block over turns, then one-shot with it
Barricade + Juggernaut = every Block card also pings the enemy
Vambrace doubles a big Block card; Sturdy Clamp banks it before you even find Barricade
archetypes.pitfalls: Without Body Slam or Juggernaut, a Block stack is just defense and you stall out. Barricade is the build — prioritize finding it.

archetypes.name: Exhaust
archetypes.summary: Turn cards leaving your deck into a resource — Block, draw, and damage per Exhaust. Thins the deck so you draw your bombs every fight.
cards: Corruption — Skills cost 0 but Exhaust when played (the engine)
Feel No Pain — gain Block whenever a card is Exhausted
Dark Embrace — draw a card whenever a card is Exhausted
Fiend Fire — Exhaust your whole hand, deal damage per card Exhausted (finisher)
Second Wind — Exhaust all non-Attacks, gain Block per card
relics: Charon's Ashes — whenever you Exhaust a card, deal damage to ALL enemies
Joss Paper — every N cards Exhausted, draw cards
Burning Sticks — first Skill you Exhaust each combat, copy it back to hand
Toasty Mittens — Exhaust your top card each turn and gain Strength
combos: Corruption + Dark Embrace + Feel No Pain = free Skills that draw AND Block on every play
Corruption + Charon's Ashes = each free Skill also nukes the room
Fiend Fire after building a fat hand = burst finisher
archetypes.pitfalls: Don't Exhaust away your win conditions. The engine needs a payoff (Feel No Pain / Dark Embrace / Charon's Ashes) or you just thin into nothing.

archetypes.name: Support: HP-as-Resource
archetypes.summary: Pay HP for tempo and energy. Splash that supercharges Strength (via Rupture) and pushes explosive turns. Pairs with Block/heal to stay alive.
cards: Bloodletting — lose HP, gain Energy
Offering — lose HP, gain Energy and draw
Hemokinesis — lose HP, deal big damage
Rupture — converts that self-damage into Strength
relics: Self-Forming Clay — whenever you lose HP in combat, gain Block next turn
Red Skull — bonus Strength while at low HP
Burning Blood — heal at the end of combat (offsets the cost)
combos: Self-damage cards + Rupture = pay HP, get Strength every time
Self-Forming Clay turns the HP you spend into Block
archetypes.pitfalls: It's HP, not free — without sustain you bleed out. Note Tungsten Rod REDUCES Rupture's payoff (less HP lost), so it's a survival pick, not a Rupture combo.

archetypes.name: Orbs 101 (read this first)
archetypes.summary: Defect channels Orbs into slots. Each Orb has a passive (every turn) and an Evoke (one-time burst when removed). Focus boosts most Orb output. Lightning hits enemies, Frost gives Block, Dark grows then bursts, Plasma gives Energy.
cards: Channel = create an Orb in a slot; Evoke = trigger and remove the leftmost/rightmost
Capacitor — gain Orb Slots (more Orbs at once)
Defragment — gain Focus (boosts Lightning/Frost/Dark output)
Dualcast / Multi-Cast / Quadcast — Evoke your rightmost Orb multiple times
relics: Cracked Core / Infused Core — start each combat Channeling Lightning
Runic Capacitor — start with extra Orb Slots
Gold Plated Cables — your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an extra time
Data Disk — start each combat with Focus
Metronome — Channel N Orbs in a combat, deal damage to ALL enemies
combos: Capacitor + a Channel engine = a wall of Orbs all triggering every turn
Gold Plated Cables doubles your most valuable rightmost Orb's passive
archetypes.pitfalls: Don't channel orbs you can't use (full slots Evoke the oldest). Pick a color identity rather than a random rainbow.

archetypes.name: Lightning (aggro)
archetypes.summary: Spam Lightning Orbs; their passive zaps a random enemy each turn (or all enemies with the right upgrade). Focus + Multicast scale it into a machine gun.
cards: Ball Lightning — deal damage and Channel a Lightning
Zap — Channel Lightning cheaply
Storm — whenever you play a Power, Channel a Lightning
Electrodynamics / Tesla — Lightning hits ALL enemies and/or trigger all Lightning
Lightning Mastery — Channel + draw + play synergy
relics: Cracked Core / Infused Core — free Lightning at combat start
Gold Plated Cables — rightmost Lightning passive triggers twice
Data Disk — Focus = each Lightning hits harder
combos: Many Lightning Orbs + Focus + Multicast = huge per-turn AoE
Electrodynamics makes every Lightning passive hit the whole room
archetypes.pitfalls: Single-target Lightning passives hit RANDOM enemies — get an 'all enemies' upgrade or it whiffs in big fights.

archetypes.name: Frost (Block / control)
archetypes.summary: Channel Frost for Block every turn — a defensive scaling shell that outlasts the enemy, then closes with a splash of damage.
cards: Glacier — gain Block and Channel Frost
Cold Snap — deal damage and Channel Frost
Chill — Channel a Frost for each enemy
Coolheaded — Channel Frost and draw
relics: Data Disk — Focus = more Block per Frost
Runic Capacitor — more Orb Slots = more Frost up at once
Gorget — start each combat with Plating
combos: Many Frost + Focus = passive Block wall every turn
Pair with a damage Orb or big Evoke to actually kill
archetypes.pitfalls: All defense, no offense = you stall out. Keep a win condition (Dark/Lightning or a big Evoke).

archetypes.name: Dark + Focus/Powers (scaling burst)
archetypes.summary: Dark Orbs grow each turn, then Evoke for a massive single hit. Powers and Focus engines (and Echo Form) make the whole deck snowball.
cards: Darkness — Channel Dark (and trigger all Dark passives to grow them faster)
Biased Cognition — huge Focus now (you lose some each turn)
Echo Form — the first card you play each turn is played twice
Creative AI — add a random Power to hand every turn
Multi-Cast — Evoke a fully-grown Dark Orb several times for a nuke
relics: Symbiotic Virus — start each combat Channeling a Dark
Mummified Hand — whenever you play a Power, a card becomes free
Game Piece — play a Power, draw cards
Lost Wisp — play a Power, deal damage to ALL enemies
Permafrost — first Power each combat, gain Block
combos: Grow Dark Orbs for a few turns, then Multi-Cast Evoke for a one-shot
Echo Form + Multi-Cast or a key Power = double everything
Mummified Hand makes a Power-heavy turn nearly free
archetypes.pitfalls: Dark is slow — it needs setup turns and survival. Don't Evoke Dark Orbs early before they've grown.

archetypes.name: Forge / Sovereign Blade (weapon)
archetypes.summary: Forge stacks empower your Sovereign Blade — a recurring weapon card that gets upgraded to hit harder, hit all enemies, and hit extra times. Build a forge engine, then swing the Blade every turn.
cards: Sovereign Blade — your signature weapon; Forge upgrades it (double damage / hits ALL / extra hits)
The Smith — Forge at the start of every turn (the engine)
Beat into Shape — deal damage, Forge, and Forge extra for each prior hit this combat
Seeking Edge — pull Sovereign Blade into your hand from anywhere and Forge
Sword Sage — Sovereign Blade now hits an additional time
Refine Blade / Heirloom Hammer / Hammer Time — extra Forge value
relics: Fencing Manual — Forge at the start of each combat (free engine start)
Vajra / Sword of Jade — start with Strength (adds to every Blade hit)
Miniature Cannon — Upgraded Attacks deal extra (Sovereign Blade scales with it)
Girya — bank Strength at rest sites
combos: Fencing Manual + The Smith = Forge from turn 1, every turn
Seeking Edge keeps the Blade in hand; Sword Sage + a 'hits all' upgrade = AoE weapon
Strength relics stack on top of every Blade hit
archetypes.pitfalls: Dead without the Blade in hand — prioritize a retrieval/forge engine. Over-forging with no swing wastes turns.

archetypes.name: Light / Cosmic (spend-Light AoE)
archetypes.summary: Generate Light each turn, then spend it for room-clearing damage and Block. A scaling caster shell that snowballs the longer the fight goes.
cards: Genesis — gain Light at the start of every turn (the engine)
Gather Light — gain Block and Light
Glow — gain Light and draw
Radiate — deal damage to ALL enemies for each Light gained this turn (payoff)
Child of the Stars — whenever you spend Light, gain Block for each Light spent
Supermassive / Big Bang / Meteor Shower — Light-fueled AoE nukes
relics: Mini Regent — the first Light you spend each turn, gain Strength
Galactic Dust — for every Light spent, gain Block
combos: Genesis ramps Light passively; dump it with Radiate/Supermassive for AoE
Big Light spends + Galactic Dust + Child of the Stars = a Block wall the same turn you nuke
Mini Regent quietly turns the Light engine into a Strength engine too
archetypes.pitfalls: Ramp-dependent — slow against fast elites. You need enough Light generation before the payoffs are worth a card.

archetypes.name: Card-Creation (scaler / glue)
archetypes.summary: Many Regent cards CREATE cards (often random Colorless). Creation payoffs reward that with Block and Strength, and finishers scale off how many cards you've made.
cards: Pillar of Creation — gain Block whenever you create a card
Bundle of Joy — add random Colorless cards to your hand
Genesis-style creation powers — Strength/Block per card created
Finishers that deal bonus damage for each card created this combat
relics: Regalite — whenever you create a card, gain Block (turns creation into a defense engine)
Fresnel Lens — auto-enchant the Block-gaining cards you add to your deck
combos: Regalite + Pillar of Creation + any card-generator = passive Block every turn
Pairs with Forge or Light as the actual damage; creation is the multiplier
archetypes.pitfalls: Creating random cards dilutes your deck — it's an engine, not a wincon. Anchor it to Forge or Light.

archetypes.name: Osty / Summon (minion beatdown)
archetypes.summary: Summon Osty, a persistent minion with his own Max HP that attacks the enemy. Buff and command him so he does the killing, and sacrifice him for a huge payoff when needed.
cards: Reanimate — Summon Osty
Osty attack cards — 'Osty deals X damage' (your main damage; many of these)
Right Hand Hand — Osty attack that returns to your hand cheaply (recurring)
Buffs — 'Osty's attacks deal additional damage' / extra attacks
Sacrifice — if Osty is alive, he dies and you gain Block equal to double his Max HP (panic button)
relics: Bone Flute — whenever Osty attacks, gain Block (defense off your offense)
Bound Phylactery — Summon at the start of your turn
Phylactery Unbound — Summon at combat start AND each turn (upgraded engine)
combos: Phylactery Unbound + Osty buffs = a minion that hits hard from turn 1, free
Bone Flute makes every Osty swing also build your Block
Sacrifice for a massive Block wall on a dangerous boss turn
archetypes.pitfalls: No Osty = most of your deck is dead cards. Protect/re-summon him, and don't Sacrifice unless the Block swing is worth losing your engine.

archetypes.name: Doom (execute / damage-over-time)
archetypes.summary: Stack Doom on enemies; it builds toward an execute. End of Days kills anything whose Doom meets its HP. Apply Doom fast and convert it to Block and survival along the way.
cards: Deathbringer — apply Doom and Weak to ALL enemies
Defile-style — apply Doom, plus extra Doom for each Doom already there (snowball)
Attack-into-Doom — 'whenever Attacks deal damage, also apply that much Doom'
End of Days — apply Doom to ALL enemies and kill any with Doom >= HP (finisher)
Doom-to-Block — 'whenever you apply Doom, gain Block'
relics: Undying Sigil — enemies with Doom >= HP deal 50% less damage (survive the ramp)
Book Repair Knife — heal HP when an enemy dies to Doom
Red Mask — start combat applying Weak to ALL (buys ramp time)
combos: Attack-applies-Doom + many small hits = Doom ramps every attack
Stack Doom across the room, then End of Days for a mass execute
Undying Sigil makes the doomed enemies harmless while you wait for the kill
archetypes.pitfalls: Doom needs time to reach lethal — survival-dependent vs fast fights. Spread too thin across many enemies and nothing dies.

archetypes.name: Soul & Ethereal (engine)
archetypes.summary: Generate Souls (special cards) and Ethereal cards (exhaust if unplayed). Playing Souls triggers summons and enemy HP loss; Ethereal payoffs reward the churn. The glue for the Osty and Doom plans.
cards: Soul generators — cards that add Souls to your draw/hand/discard
Soul payoffs — 'whenever you play a Soul, Summon' / 'a random enemy loses HP'
Spirit of Ash — gain Block whenever you play an Ethereal card
Ethereal draw — 'whenever you draw an Ethereal card, draw more'
Eidolon — Exhaust your hand; if 9 cards exhaust, gain Intangible
relics: Music Box — create an Ethereal copy of the first Attack you play each turn
(few Soul/Ethereal-specific relics confirmed — lean on draw/retain relics to keep the churn going)
combos: Soul payoff + a Soul-generation engine = free Summons / chip damage every turn
Ethereal payoffs (Spirit of Ash) turn the natural churn into Block
archetypes.pitfalls: Souls/Ethereal are fuel, not a kill on their own — pair with Osty or Doom. Ethereal cards vanish if unplayed, so build around the churn, not against it.
